Subject: Quick follow-up: architecture deep-dive & next meeting windows

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Good signal on the use cases you shared for patient record anonymization and multi‑tenant inference. A couple quick next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Proposal: 60‑minute architecture deep‑dive (tech leads + infra) to map integration points and expected throughput.
- Ask: can you confirm whether your team prefers a hands‑on demo with your sample data or a conceptual architecture review first?

I tried to send a calendar invite for a 60‑minute slot on Mon/Tue but heard back from SalesOps that the invite arrived with PST timestamps and the join link showed our internal test bridge (apologies). I’m re‑proposing slots below (all in UTC for clarity):

1) Tue 2027-01-12 15:00–16:00 UTC
2) Wed 2027-01-13 09:00–10:00 UTC
3) Wed 2027-01-13 16:00–17:00 UTC

If none of those work, tell us two preferred windows and we’ll make it happen.

Attached also is a short mutual action plan to align stakeholders and success criteria. If you prefer, Jordan (cc’d) can send the event from his calendar so we avoid the ICS timezone swap we hit earlier.

Thanks —

--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Thanks for the recap. Apologies — SalesOps didn’t get the invite initially, and when it arrived the time showed as 3pm PST (we’re EST). Looks like the calendar event converted to a local time incorrectly.

We’d prefer a conceptual review first (mapping to our compliance needs) and then a hands‑on demo on a follow‑up call. Of the slots you listed, Tue 2027-01-12 15:00–16:00 UTC works for our architecture lead (that’s 10am EST). Please resend the invite with explicit timezone and a working join URL.

Also, can you include a brief agenda and the names of engineers attending? That helps us loop in the right people.
